certificate.description: A sequence of triangular polynomial substitutions, each fixing the origin with Jacobian determinant one, gives coordinates in which the exceptional images lie in the singular locus and the faces over the origin are nondegenerate. The strict transform is smooth and transverse to the toric strata over the origin.
